description: This file defines classes and functions related to scalar replacement optimization in Torch's JIT tensor expression compiler, including analysis and transformation of tensor buffer accesses for efficient code generation.

classes.name: AccessInfo
classes.description: Holds analysis information about tensor buffer accesses, including load/store counts, costs, and associated scope.

classes.name: Scope
classes.description: Represents a scope block containing tensor buffer accesses, managing access maps and nested scopes.

classes.name: RegisterizerAnalysis
classes.description: Analyzes tensor access patterns to identify candidates for scalar replacement, traversing the IR tree.

classes.name: RegisterizerReplacer
classes.description: Replaces tensor buffer accesses with scalar variables based on analysis, performing the actual IR mutation.

methods.name: registerize
methods.description: Applies scalar replacement optimization to the given statement.
